meta.title: Extend the vendor's submission time
gaps: A vendor submitting after the original submission end time in a separate vendor session.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: A vendor submitting after the original submission end time in a separate vendor session.

args.goal: Open the prospect's Vendor Profile Page, open Onboarding Details, extend the submission time, and stop on the screen showing the new submission end time.

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated Vendor Profile or Onboarding Details step, so perform and verify the buyer-side extension in the current session.

args.need: sign in as the onboarding vendor and submit after the original submission end time to verify the vendor can still submit

steps.note: A separate vendor session and post-deadline submission are not available in the catalog.
Verify the vendor submission completed after the tester performs the missing vendor-side action.
